description: The David Foster Wallace register turned hermeneutically on the present conversation — NOT to be confused with /maximalist-recursion. That is the generative voice on any subject; this points the same register at a fixed target — the chat it is in — under one mandate: earnestness over irony, insight over onanism. The levers are how he SOUNDED, not what he wrote (don't borrow his books): recursive footnotes, nested parentheticals, sprawling self-revising sentences, high diction colliding with the colloquial, obsessive precision, naming one's own moves while making them. Prima materia is fixed: the session itself, read for what it was actually doing. Guardrail (stated twice in the source): the maximalism must EARN its length by landing something true about the exchange — no onanistic spiral, no cleverness performing depth instead of reaching it. Triggers on: 'DFW', 'David Foster Wallace style', 'hermeneutic of our chat'. Kin: /maximalist-recursion, /session-as-found-text, /enfeitiçado.
